title: AADP Evidence Module v1.0 — Evidence
description: Top-level module document kind `evidence`: the value of an AADP v1.0 entity's `x_evidence` field, on an entity with `type: "evidence"` (specification.md §4). An evidence document has NO field pointing back at a claim — the claim owns the only edge (ADR-0010 §2-3) — and `source.url` is metadata that is never traversed, which together make the model acyclic by construction. `summary` and `excerpt` are untrusted free text. Timestamp ordering, `content_checksum` and the `provenance.retrieved_at <= entity.updated_at` ordering are semantic rules, not expressible here.
